commits.message:
fix(columns): lay out through Table.grid, as Rich's Columns does (rich-columns-i08a)

Columns keeps only its column-count search and hands the cells to a
Table.grid with collapsePadding and no padEdge; its own spacing, stretch
and row-separator code is gone. Table gains what that needs, each ported
from Rich's Table:

- collapsePadding and padEdge options, giving per-column and per-row padding
- padding above and below a cell is drawn (it was ignored)
- the `maximum or 1` floor, handed back when the table is squeezed
  (rich-table-r9aq)
- cells sized by their own measurement, not String(cell) or the whole
  text's length (rich-table-ca0, rich-table-pyrl)
- cells handed the table's rows as a ceiling, per the Height contract

A Columns' declared width is each column's natural width rather than a
Table column width, so expand still stretches it as Rich does.

fix(table): stretch an expanding table by Rich's ratio_distribute (rich-table-d1uy) (#230)

* fix(table): stretch an expanding table by Rich's ratio_distribute (rich-table-d1uy)

An expanding table handed its leftover cells out by largest remainder over
content widths; Rich 9d8f9a3 uses ratio_distribute over widths that include
padding, rounding each share up. The two agree on totals and disagree on
which column takes a leftover cell. The stretch now goes through
ratioDistribute (src/renderables/ratio.ts), weighted by padded width.

The rowless maxWidth 7/3 frame the suite pinned as "Rich's own output" was
not: Rich prints 24/13 there, which is what this renders.

* fix(ratio): split in exact integers, as Rich's ratio_distribute does (rich-table-d1uy)

A double's ratio * remaining rounds past 2^53, so near MAX_SAFE_INTEGER the
parts stopped summing to the total — reachable from Table.measure's declared
branch at an unbounded offer. The stretch comment no longer claims the
columns it weighs are Rich's.

fix(pretty): one-piece text wraps under its key instead of running to column 0 (rich-pretty-xms.tmf)

A scalar, a self-describing value, or a marker placed inside a container
is cut to the width left on its line; its continuation lines, its own
included, hang one indent past its slot. A value whose first word does
not fit after its key starts on a hanging line. The root stays unplaced:
its line is its caller's.

fix(renderables): every exported renderable ends its own line or is listed as a fragment (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq)

Spinner, Status, Pretty, JSON and a Layout leaf left their last line open,
so a Group ran what followed onto it; Rich ends all five. test/seam/line-ends.ts
derives every exported Renderable class and requires an entry saying which
side of the line it sits on, rendering each to check. ProgressBar, Emoji and
the Progress columns are fragments, as in Rich.
